description: This Java source file defines a class NoopResourceLimitChecks that implements the ResourceLimitChecks interface. The class provides no-op implementations of methods checking connection and message limits, always returning false to indicate limits are never reached.

classes.name: NoopResourceLimitChecks
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of ResourceLimitChecks that always indicates resource limits are not reached.

methods.name: isConnectionLimitReached
methods.description: Checks whether the connection limit has been reached for a tenant. Always returns false.

methods.name: isMessageLimitReached
methods.description: Checks whether the message limit has been reached for a tenant considering payload size. Always returns false.
